content:
**RootMC — Plugin sales research (Jul 2026)**
Channel for planning public paid plugins, web pages, and marketplace listings.

---

**1) Tier-1 paid marketplaces (primary sell targets)**

**SpigotMC Resources (premium)**
• https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/
• Largest Java plugin audience; still the default place server owners look
• Platform fee: **0%** — you keep 100% of sale; payments are buyer↔seller (usually PayPal)
• Price cap: **$0.99–$19.99** USD
• Seller gate (must meet before premium upload):
  – Account ≥ 8 weeks old
  – 80 forum posts + 20 positive ratings
  – **3 free resources** published
  – 2FA enabled
• Approval often ~1 week; “low effort” / common genres can be rejected
• **DRM / license keys that block the jar from running are prohibited** — plugin must work from downloaded file; obfuscation allowed with caveats
• Guidelines: https://www.spigotmc.org/threads/premium-resource-guidelines.31667/
• Best for: max discoverability + free funnel into paid products

**BuiltByBit (ex MC-Market)**
• https://builtbybit.com/resources/categories/minecraft-plugins.1/
• Paid plugins browse: https://builtbybit.com/resources/minecraft/plugins/paid/
• Creators: https://builtbybit.com/resources/creators
• Platform fee: **~9.9%** + payment gateway fees; payouts via **Tebex wallet**
• No hard Spigot-style $19.99 ceiling (higher prices OK; mins often ~$1.99–$5.99 by category)
• Also sells maps, configs, models, **custom plugin commissions**
• Pro seller features / referrals optional
• Best for: premium buyers, higher price points, services + products

**Polymart**
• https://polymart.org/ — plugins: https://polymart.org/products/category/2/plugins
• Modern marketplace with **built-in checkout**, buyer management, license delivery
• Takes a **% fee per sale** (check current schedule on-site when listing)
• Developer API (purchase verify / updates): https://www.polymart.org/wiki/api
• Supports Spigot/Paper/Velocity/Bungee/etc. tags

• Best for: cleaner store UX + automated delivery without self-hosting payments

Comparison write-up: https://mclicense.org/blog/spigotmc-vs-polymart-vs-builtbybit

---

**2) Emerging / niche paid marketplaces**

**Hye** — https://hye.gg/
• “Try plugin 30 min on temp server before buy”
• Claims **~5% creator fee**; Stripe; license signing; plugins/mods/builds
• Worth evaluating for modern buyer conversion

**PulsePlugin** — https://pulseplugin.net/
• Per-buyer encrypted builds / anti-leak focus
• Claims **70% to creator** (30% platform)
• Seller apply flow on site — evaluate maturity before relying on it

**TrustMyServer marketplace** — https://trustmyserver.com/marketplace
• Multi-game (Minecraft included); Stripe Connect
• Claims **~10% platform / 90% creator**; instant payouts

**GameServersHub (GSH)** — https://gameservershub.com/become-a-creator
• Plugins/maps/assets; claims **10% fee**, instant payouts
• Broader “game server” audience, not MC-only

**AdvancedPlugins** — https://advancedplugins.net/
• Studio/storefront model (own products + shop), not a open open-to-all marketplace like Spigot
• Useful as a **reference for premium presentation / own-brand store**, not as a listing portal

**Craftaro / Songoda (legacy note)**
• Songoda content moved into Craftaro historically; treat as **verify-before-use** — do not assume active open seller onboarding without checking craftaro.com today

---

**3) Free / discovery hubs (NOT for paywalled jars)**

These are critical for **reputation, SEO, and free editions** — paid full versions usually live elsewhere.

**Hangar (PaperMC)** — https://hangar.papermc.io/
• Official Paper/Velocity plugin repo
• Guidelines: https://hangar.papermc.io/guidelines
• **No paywalls / no license keys required for core functionality**
• OK: donation links, Patreon for *early free previews*, docs, support Discord
• Use for: free/lite builds + Paper credibility

**Modrinth** — https://modrinth.com/
• Hosts plugins (and mods); great search/API

• **No paid downloads** (not planned)
• Monetization = **ad rewards program** (pageviews/downloads → payout share), not jar sales
• https://modrinth.com/news/article/creator-monetization
• https://modrinth.com/legal/cmp-info

**CurseForge (Bukkit Plugins)** — https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins
• Large free download traffic; Overwolf ecosystem
• Treat as free distribution / discovery, not Spigot-style premium sales

**Ore (Sponge)** — https://ore.spongepowered.org/
• Sponge plugins; **selling / paid unlocks forbidden**
• Guidelines ban monetized feature gates

**BukkitDev (legacy)** — historically CurseForge Bukkit; many classics still mirrored there
• Low priority for new paid RootMC products

**Paper forums** — forums being wound down; hangout = Paper Discord + Hangar uploads
• https://forums.papermc.io/ (redirects community to Discord/Hangar)

---

**4) Own-store / delivery infrastructure (recommended alongside marketplaces)**

**rootmc.net plugin pages (our plan)**
• Branded product pages, docs, changelogs, purchase CTAs
• Can deep-link to Spigot/Polymart/BBB *or* sell direct

**Tebex** — https://www.tebex.io/ (+ wallet used by BuiltByBit)
• Industry-standard game-server commerce; packages, coupons, Discord roles, in-game delivery plugins
• Strong for **server stores**; also used as payout rail on BBB

**MC License** — https://mclicense.org/
• Cross-marketplace license keys / analytics; imports Spigot + Polymart + BuiltByBit
• Useful if we list on multiple sites and need one license brain
• **Note:** Spigot premium rules conflict with hard license locks — design carefully per platform

**Direct PayPal / Stripe + download portal**
• Highest control; need fraud/refund handling, hosting, ToS, VAT awareness
• Often paired with free Spigot listing → paid upgrade on Polymart/BBB/own site

---

**5) Development communities (not stores, but where buyers & reputation live)**

• Spigot forums / Discord — https://www.spigotmc.org/

• Paper Discord + Hangar — https://papermc.io/
• BuiltByBit plugin-dev commissions forum — https://builtbybit.com/forums/development/minecraft-plugins/
• Polymart seller/buyer community (on-site)
• GitHub / GitLab public repos for open components
• Minecraft Partner / Bedrock Marketplace — https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace
  – **Different product** (Bedrock content, Microsoft 70/30). Not Java Spigot plugins. Mention only if we ever ship Bedrock packs.

---

**6) Practical RootMC go-to-market plan**

**Phase A — Inventory**
• List Gen1 plugins eligible for public paid release (unique value, supportable, EULA-safe)
• Decide free “lite” vs premium full for each

**Phase B — Accounts & gates**
• Spigot: start/maintain account activity + publish **3 free** resources to unlock premium
• Open seller accounts: BuiltByBit, Polymart (priority)
• Evaluate Hye / GSH / TrustMyServer as secondary after Tier-1 is live

**Phase C — Packaging**
• Professional resource pages: feature list, screenshots, video, docs URL, support Discord
• Version matrix (Paper versions), dependencies, changelog
• Pricing strategy: Spigot ≤ $19.99; BBB/Polymart can carry higher “complete suite” SKUs if needed
• Licensing: Spigot-safe (no hard online lock); Polymart/BBB can use their license APIs

**Phase D — Web**
• New rootmc.net pages: plugin catalog, per-plugin product page, purchase links, docs
• Optional: aggregate “download portal” that deep-links to marketplace files (don’t violate reupload rules)

**Phase E — Multi-list**
• Same plugin on Spigot + Polymart + BuiltByBit maximizes reach (audiences don’t fully overlap)
• Centralize licenses/support so buyers aren’t orphaned across sites

**Phase F — Forums / discovery**
• Free builds on Hangar + Modrinth for SEO and trust
• Premium CTA → paid marketplace / rootmc.net
• Never paywall Hangar/Modrinth jars

---

**7) Quick decision matrix**

| Goal | Where |
|---|---|
| Max eyes / classic buyers | SpigotMC premium |

| Higher price / pro buyers / services | BuiltByBit |
| Modern checkout + licenses | Polymart |
| Free Paper credibility | Hangar |
| Free SEO / launcher discovery | Modrinth (+ ad rewards only) |
| Own brand storefront | rootmc.net (+ Tebex/Stripe) |
| Cross-site license brain | MC License (careful with Spigot rules) |
| Try-before-buy experiments | Hye |

---

**8) Next actions for this channel**
1. Pick first 3–5 plugins for public paid release
2. Draft rootmc.net plugin page wireframes
3. Create/verify Spigot + Polymart + BuiltByBit seller accounts
4. Confirm Spigot free-resource plan to unlock premium
5. Shortlist Hye vs GSH as optional 4th/5th listing later

Questions / corrections welcome — fees and seller rules change; re-check each site’s terms before first upload.
